services.desc: Mastering upwind sailing or performing the perfect roll tack are noble skill sets for any sailor. The complexity of sailing creates a challenging, yet alluring drive to succeed and understand the forces at work in our sport. While sailing fast is appealing to a select group, harnessing the wind, waves, and the mechanics of sailing are natural motivators for all youth to pursue sailing (and science) as a life-long interest. blurb: Community Boating Center (CBC) is a non-profit 501(c)3 organization offering sailing lessons, youth summer camps, and kayak and paddleboard rentals. It operates a fleet of over 60 boats and is located at India Point Park in Providence, Rhode Island. CBC is an accredited US Sailing Community Sailing Center providing public access to boating education and recreation.
